purpose: Extend historical threshold evidence without changing frozen training inputs or fitting a new model
source_frame: Recheck existing audited original releases; follow original-publisher links/searches for the final28days of each of the six campaigns. Convenience extension, not an exhaustive/random poll sample.
inclusion: Original commissioner/publisher, actual historical lineup, explicit pre-election publication date, numeric party vote-intention percentages when reported and complete seat tables when recoverable. Include all such percentages in a reviewed release, retaining unresolved labels separately, without selecting by final result.
exclusions: Secondary republications remain discovery-only; exit polls, actual results as predictors, hypothetical/incorrect lineups, dates outside28days and unverified graphic/PDF numbers are not admitted as new observations.
unknowns: Unknown percentage, denominator, weighting/undecided treatment, fieldwork or sample remain null. No vote shares inferred from seats; positive seats do not supply a numerical percentage bound on a different questionnaire denominator.
historical_vintage: Retrospective publisher-source audit; no authenticated contemporary archive versions. Preserve known revision dates and temporal gates; publication dates are not fieldwork proxies.
identity: Reuse election-specific IDs and Hebrew labels; no current form aliases applied to historical records. Preserve firm and commissioner separately; shared firms do not become independent because publishers differ.
model_use: Separate reviewed overlay and coverage/availability exports only. No automatic promotion into frozen models, no new fit or current forecast change.
rights: Factual numerical transcriptions with attribution; publisher prose/images/full pages are not redistributed. Downloaded raw publisher bytes were not available through the reader; no raw-response checksum is invented. Versioned numerical inputs/code are hashed.
